root_cause.text: In the `ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb()` function in `net/mac80211/tx.c`, the error path when `ieee80211_tx_prepare()` returns `TX_DROP` fails to free the socket buffer (`skb`), unlike the other two error paths, causing a memory leak or inconsistent ownership that required callers to free the skb themselves.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kfree_skb(skb);` in the first error path (line 1902: `if (ieee80211_tx_prepare(...) == TX_DROP) { kfree_skb(skb); return false; }`) and removes redundant `dev_kfree_skb_any`/`ieee80211_free_txskb`/`kfree_skb` from callers (ath9k, mt76, mac80211_hwsim) to avoid double-free, confirming the inconsistency.

intent_record.intent_summary: Change failure handling to return early instead of goto error, likely to prevent incorrect cleanup or resource leaks when probe preparation fails.
intent_record.what: In the function ath_scan_send_probe, the failure branch of ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb is changed from `goto error;` to `return;`.
intent_record.how: If ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb fails, the function now returns immediately instead of jumping to an error label, thus skipping any cleanup or additional processing that the error label would have executed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant/dangerous skb free on failure in ath_chanctx_send_vif_ps_frame to prevent double-free.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to dev_kfree_skb_any(skb) inside the conditional block when ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb returns false, leaving only the return false statement.
intent_record.how: When ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb fails, the function will no longer free the skb before returning false, preventing a potential double-free or memory corruption.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential double-free by removing redundant skb free on tx_prepare failure, as the skb is already freed in the common out path.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to ieee80211_free_txskb inside the failure branch of ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb, simplifying the conditional to a bare goto out.
intent_record.how: On failure of ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb, the skb is no longer explicitly freed before jumping to out, relying on the common exit path to handle cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a bug where kfree_skb was incorrectly called after ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb failure, avoiding a potential double-free or use-after-free.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to kfree_skb(probe) inside an if block that handles failure of ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb in the hw_scan_work function.
intent_record.how: Previously, on failure of ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb, the probe skb was freed and the loop continued. Now the skb is not freed on that error path, which prevents a potential double-free or use-after-free if the skb is already freed or owned elsewhere.

intent_record.intent_summary: Document that the function frees the skb on failure and callers must not free it again.
intent_record.what: The comment for the function's return value is updated: a period is added at the end of the existing sentence, and two new sentences are added stating that on failure the skb is freed by this function and callers must not free it again.
intent_record.how: No runtime behavior change; the documentation now explicitly informs developers of the skb ownership transfer on failure, reducing the risk of double-free bugs.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing skb when ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP.
intent_record.what: Added braces and a call to kfree_skb(skb) inside the if block that handles the TX_DROP case from ieee80211_tx_prepare, before returning false.
intent_record.how: When ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP, the skb is now freed to avoid a memory leak, and then false is returned.

grouping_result.intent: Fix memory leak by freeing skb when ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP.
Fix potential double-free by removing redundant skb free on tx_prepare failure, as the skb is already freed in the common out path.
Document that the function frees the skb on failure and callers must not free it again.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix memory/resource management bugs in ieee80211_tx error handling paths
Fix potential double-free by removing redundant skb free on failure paths.

relevance_review.reason: Hunk 5 directly fixes the memory leak when ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP, which is exactly the vulnerability root cause described. The other hunks also address related resource management issues in the same error handling paths, making the group overall relevant.

The group removes redundant skb frees in callers that were added because the core function (ieee80211_tx_prepare_skb) did not free the skb on the TX_DROP error path, causing a memory leak or ownership inconsistency. This change is directly related to fixing the aftermath of the root cause vulnerability.
The group documents the corrected behavior where the function now frees the skb on failure, directly addressing the memory leak vulnerability.

candidates.rationale: When ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP, the function returns false without freeing the skb, causing a memory leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: When ieee80211_tx_prepare returns TX_DROP, this return statement is executed without first freeing the skb (socket buffer), causing a memory leak or inconsistent ownership. The fix adds a kfree_skb(skb) call before this return.
